title: Dairy-Free Keto Board
seo_title: Dairy-Free Keto Charcuterie Board (No Cheese): Shopping List
description: A dairy-free keto board for 6 with no cheese: salami, prosciutto, chorizo, smoked salmon, eggs, avocado, olives, pickles, macadamia nuts and crunchy vegetables.
hook: All the richness, none of the cheese: a keto board for guests who can't have dairy.
why: Without cheese, the richness has to come from somewhere else, and here it's avocado, macadamia nuts, smoked salmon and eggs. Salami, prosciutto and dry chorizo bring the salt and spice.

Two kinds of olives, pickles and whole-grain mustard give it the sharp notes a cheese board usually gets from aged cheese, and cucumbers, celery and radishes carry everything. About 8 g net carbs per serving.

timeline.what: Slice the vegetables and avocado (lemon or lime over it).
Build the board; keep the salmon in the fridge.

faq.q: Can you make a charcuterie board without cheese?
faq.a: Yes. Use cured meats, smoked salmon, avocado, eggs, olives, pickles, nuts and crunchy vegetables. Avocado and nuts give the richness cheese usually brings.
Most salami, prosciutto and chorizo are, but some sausages use milk powder as a binder. Check the label.
About 8 g net carbs per serving for 6.
